v1_gesture_signature: Two right-turn patterns, two left patterns, two left patterns, two right patterns, then a small front lean and stand.
v2_adaptation: V1 executes right-turn, left-turn, left-turn, right-turn groups then a small front lean. V2 preserves right scan, through center to left scan, recenter, and front lean; planted 12-degree body yaw replaces repeated V1 footsteps to make a compact stationary inspection gesture. This is an intentional choreography adaptation, not a literal replay of the V1 turn trajectories.
angle_mapping: No electrical degree values copied. Twelve geometric joint angles solved from measured mechanism or deliberately bounded airborne branch-valid paths.
timing: V1 frame order/repetition retained semantically; V2 research timing independently defined in config.json, with synchronized smooth joint samples. Timing and electrical staggering are separate execution concerns.
